observed_anchors: Merged single ClayVM exists; current canonical VM surface remains Int/Bool-narrow.
Merged ClayOS linux.process.spawn.v0 component exists, but no canonical Clay String/Bytes/argv/effect path reaches it.
Current next discriminator selects the smallest canonical Bytes/Buffer ownership+lifetime plus String/argv/effect-signature surface needed by CM-DATA and CM-TERM.
hypothesis: A single-file EntityOS packaging boundary can already be exercised independently of the still-open canonical String/Bytes/effect semantics, exposing packaging/hidden-sidecar failures early.
counterhypothesis: The current compiler/VM/ClayOS architecture implicitly requires repository sidecars or ambient project state, so one-file execution will fail in an amputated clean-room directory.

unusual_experiment.name: dependency-amputation clean-room run
unusual_experiment.method: Copy only EntityOS into a fresh temporary directory, clear the environment except HOME/PATH/LANG, run --self-test, compare artifact hash, then delete the directory.

limitations: This candidate is not the accepted Clay Machine and does not close whole-machine acceptance.
It does not contain the full current repository compiler/evaluator/ClayOS implementation; it is a bounded product-boundary bootstrap using the current merged ClayVM v0 shape and source bindings.
It depends on host Python 3 and therefore is not yet a self-contained native/static runtime.
It does not solve canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership/lifetime, String/argv, effectful TypedIR, VM object surface, or provenance-bound process requests.
exact_blocker: Canonical Clay String/Bytes/argv plus effect signatures and ownership/lifetime semantics are not admitted through checker -> effectful executable TypedIR -> single ClayVM -> merged ClayOS linux.process.spawn.v0; the local one-file bootstrap cannot substitute for those missing semantics.
next_executable_action: Implement the smallest immutable String and owned immutable Bytes value representation plus argv list shape in the canonical type/effect checker and single ClayVM, then add one capability-gated process-spawn intrinsic through effectful TypedIR with provenance-bound request snapshot; run existing exact-head gates and rebuild EntityOS from those admitted components.
